To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hadron elliptic flow is determined by that of the produced partons, which is in turn determined by the initial partonic elliptic flow, the hadronization dynamics, and hadronic rescattering.

(1) the parton anisotropic flow can be extracted from hadron anisotropies by using a simple relation, (2) the parton flow is larger than the hadron flow, and (3) the parton elliptic flow can be used to determine the shear viscosity of the partonic phase.

(1) the hadronization of parton matter is a process that is strongly coupled and is characterized by the recombination of partons into hadrons; (2) hadronization of the initial partonic matter is a process of quark recombination, while hadronization of hadronic matter produced in the later stages is dominated by the hadron-hadron coalescence.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the parton degrees of freedom in the hadronization of the quark-gluon plasma and its relation to hadronic observables.
the hadronization process and the hadronization dynamics of partonic matter.
understanding how partons and hadrons are related and what we learn from hadron observables at RHIC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RHIC experimental data are consistent with the formation of a deconfined partonic matter, which subsequently hadronizes via recombination of partons.
the RHIC data have provided strong evidence that the initial state is partonic and strongly interacting, and that hadrons are formed via coalescence of partons.
the observed large anisotropic flow in heavy ion collisions is the result of a strong interaction in the initial partonic matter, and the hadronization dynamics plays a minor role.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
hadron elliptic flow is sensitive to the hadronization dynamics and the partonic flow is more sensitive to the partonic interaction and its initial condition.
parton flow can be extracted from hadron anisotropy, which can be used to constrain the hadronization dynamics of partons and to determine the partonic matter properties.
the hadronic flow is a direct probe to the initial partonic matter and its hadronizing dynamics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hadron elliptic flow is a convolution of the elliptic flow of produced partons, the hadronization dynamics, and the hadron-hadron interactions in the hadronic matter.
the hadron elliptic flow is not simply proportional to the elliptic flow of produced partons but depends on the details of the parton to hadron conversion process.

hadron elliptic flows measured in heavy-ion collisions at RHIC can be well reproduced if the initial parton elliptic flow is assumed to be about 50% of that of the hadrons, which is consistent with a parton-hadron coalescence scenario.
